# Arts Advocacy | NFHS

> A resource hub for advocating interscholastic performing arts programs and promoting student wellness through arts participation.

The National Federation of State High School Associations (NFHS) operates this advocacy platform to champion performing arts in middle and high schools. The site provides resources, research, and tools to support arts education and student participation.
